artifact_observations.reasoning: The transparent surfaces lack realistic reflections and refractions. They appear as slightly hazy, semi-transparent gray shapes rather than clear glass or plastic, blending oddly with the background.

The front end lacks defined geometric precision. The headlight on the right appears to melt into the bodywork, and the bumper line is inconsistent and wavy, lacking the rigid structure of a real vehicle.

The vertical pillars supporting the roof show slight warping and inconsistency in thickness. The connection points where the pillars meet the roof and the body are soft and ill-defined, suggesting minor geometric instability.

The details of the wheel hubs are smeared. While this could be motion blur or depth of field, the static nature of the image and the sharpness of nearby grass suggest it is an AI generation artifact (smearing) rather than optical blur.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the front-end geometry. AI models often struggle with the complex curves of bumpers and headlights, resulting in 'melting' or asymmetry. Also, evaluate the transparency of the windshield; AI often fails to render correct refraction/reflection, making glass look like solid gray plastic. Check if the roof pillars align vertically with the wheel wells, as misalignment is a common structural error in generated vehicles.
